Experience is limited to one fictional 2,400-application career-college pilot and a small internal admissions demo, lacking any comparable 18,000-application production reference.
criterion_results.evidence: Support is 08:00-17:00 Eastern on weekdays. P1 acknowledgement is targeted within two business hours; no after-hours P1 rota or contractual service credit is offered. BrightPath lists one fictional 2,400-application career-college pilot and a small internal admissions demo, with no comparable 18,000-application production reference.

risks: Fast launch assumes all four connections are template-compatible; custom connectors add cost and time.
The submitted retention, independent testing, and incident evidence do not yet meet the stated baseline.
Migration cleansing and load preparation sit with the university without a quantified effort estimate.
suppliers.overall_summary: BrightPath Tech proposes a hosted portal and standard admissions workflow featuring the fastest proposed launch (12 weeks) and the lowest three-year total cost of ownership ($250,000). However, the proposal contains significant scope and evidence gaps, particularly regarding technical architecture specifics, integration mapping, limited weekday-only support, lack of comparable large-scale references, and substantial security and compliance gaps including missing independent audits and retention plan shortcomings.
